blocks.html:
Custom Designed Wrap For Club Car Golf Cart

Vehicles no matter what kind are an important part of our lives. And since we see them every day, it is natural to want to customize them the way we want. Something that we want to see and something that’ll make us stand out in the crowd.

Vinyl Wrap Toronto is privileged to be able to make that happen for our clients. No Matter what kind of vehicle or object, our motto is that we can wrap almost anything.

We recently wrapped an entire RV for a client. You know the client is satisfied with the work when they start referring the service to their friends and family. That RV job brought us 2 more jobs as a result. The client for whom we did the RV mentioned our ability to transform a vehicle into a masterpiece to one of their friends and as a result, that friend of theirs came to us to get his Club Car Golf Cart Fully Wrapped.

Just like every client, this man had a vision of how he wanted his Club Car Golf Cart to look like. He originally had a design in his mind for his Golf Cart. This F1 Ferrari Inspired Design was mocked up. Our designers knowing very well the importance of making a client happy gave him 4 different designs to choose from. 2 of them based on Ferrari F1 racing car and 2 based on Flames. The client chose the design with blue flames on it for the Club Car Golf Cart.

That’s all we needed to start the production process. We printed the design onto Avery Dennison’s Printable Vinyl using our latest printing equipment, Laminated and passed the material to our installers. Installers are the people who make it happen. They’re the professionals who turn the digital mockup into reality.

Installers at Vinyl Wrap Toronto have been working in the industry for more than a decade and we’re confident to say they’re capable of turning an ordinary vehicle into a fantasy vehicle. This is exactly what they did for this Club Car Golf Cart.

We’ve attached pictures of the Golf Cart on this page for you to see the difference vinyl wraps can make to your vehicle.

Have an idea for customizing your vehicle? Contact us and let’s get the ball rolling. Our designers and installers will make sure you walk out of our garage with a cool one-of-a-kind car, van or motorcycle. From full wraps to small decals, we do it all using the best quality material available on the market. We only use premium quality material offered by Avery Dennison & 3M.

For any questions or to get a quote, give us a call at 416-746-1381 or visit our garage located at 24 Ronson Dr, Unit 1, Etobicoke, ON, M9W1B4 to see us in action and speak to one of our experts.

To read more stories, visit our blog page. Check out more recreational wraps here.
